department: F. Joseph Halcomb III, M.D. Department of Biomedical Engineering

deadline.value: The department Q&A does not give the PhD deadline.

supervisor.value: Every incoming student needs at least one faculty member willing to advise them.
supervisor.quote: Each incoming student must have at least one faculty member who is willing to serve as an advisor for that student.

funding.value: Research assistantships are awarded competitively by faculty; there are no teaching assistantships.
funding.quote: Research Assistant (RA) positions are available and are awarded on a competitive basis.

entry_route.value: An M.S. is expected, though exceptionally qualified applicants can enter the PhD directly.
entry_route.quote: Exceptionally qualified individuals can be admitted directly into the Ph.D. program without having to have completed an M.S. degree first.

gre_general.value: The department lists official GRE scores as a Graduate School requirement for applicants.
gre_general.quote: The Graduate School requires an application and fee, official transcripts, official GRE scores and official TOEFL scores.

notes: The department GRE statement conflicts with the Graduate School's list (which does not name biomedical engineering) and with the IBS statement; the department's own page is used. Prerequisite is a bachelor's from an ABET-accredited engineering program or equivalent.
